observation.zero_sample_meaning: No direct xref or string match cannot rule out virtual/indirect calls, inlining or other scheduling paths.
observation.stop_condition: Read-only exact EXE and script extraction, bounded direct-call/RTTI/string traversal from acceptance and AI interaction anchors; preserve residual unknowns if a production edge cannot be proven. Never run CK3 or invoke native routines.
